references.text: The disciples worshiped Jesus when they saw him after the resurrection, showing a similar reaction to the women in verse 9.
Thomas calls Jesus 'my Lord and my God', which reflects the worship Jesus receives.
The prophecy that the righteous will shine like the sun in their Father's kingdom can be seen in light of Jesus' resurrection and meeting with him.
The call to worship the Lord in holy splendor may be connected to the worship Jesus receives after his resurrection.
